Use `Live` with an updated renderable for a changing terminal display; its cursor-control handling is documented in [Live Display](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst). `rich.print` sanitizes carriage returns in text, while `flush` only flushes the rendered output. For usage questions, please ask on [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
